pattern: Static content grouped with role=group and named by its visible label; with href, a single native link wrapping the whole card. The change is spelled out in visually hidden text; the visible signed amount is aria-hidden so it is not read twice.

roles.role: link (native <a href>), named by its content

aria.value: "true"; the visually hidden text reads '{increase|decrease|no change} of {amount}[, favorable|unfavorable]'

keyboard.action: The card is one tab stop (the link).

focus: A linked card shows a focus-ring-width outline in color-focus-ring with focus-ring-offset. A plain card is not focusable.
notes: Favorable/unfavorable is conveyed by text ('increase of 20%, favorable'; the sign is spoken as the direction word) and by the arrow direction, not by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
Sentiment 'neutral' and a zero change omit the favorable/unfavorable wording.
While busy the value reads 'Loading' and the change is not shown.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
A linked card's accessible name is its whole text content (label, value, spelled-out change, caption, and description), which can be long.
